single_prompt: A close-up shows hands holding a new white pleated 3M Filtrete 16x25x1 air filter with red and white branding, tilting it to catch the light on the dimensions. The camera shifts to an over-the-shoulder view as hands rip the clear plastic wrapping off the filter and set it aside. In a medium shot, a person walks up to a white slatted wall-mounted return air vent in a well-lit residential hallway and reaches for the top edge. A close-up reveals thumbs pressing down on the two top metal sliding latches simultaneously, releasing them. The camera pulls back to a medium close-up as the metal vent grille swings downward on its bottom hinges, exposing a dark gray, dust-covered old filter inside the wall cavity. From a first-person view, fingers pinch the top cardboard frame of the dirty old filter and slowly pull it completely out of the wall duct, keeping it level. An over-the-shoulder view shows the dirty filter being slid directly into a large black plastic trash bag held open by the person's other hand. An extreme close-up focuses on an index finger tapping the printed 'Airflow' arrow on the side of the new filter's cardboard edge. From a first-person view, hands rotate the new filter so the airflow arrow points directly toward the dark opening of the wall duct. A medium close-up shows hands sliding the new 16x25x1 filter into the metal housing, guiding the bottom edge in first. A close-up captures fingers pressing the four corners of the new filter's cardboard frame to ensure it sits completely flush against the inner metal lip. In a medium close-up, hands lift the slatted metal vent grille, swinging it back up on its hinges toward the wall to cover the new filter. A close-up shows thumbs pushing the two metal latches upward until they click into the locked position. Finally, a medium shot shows a hand wiping the exterior horizontal slats of the closed return air vent with a yellow microfiber cloth to remove any residual dust.
